Are you looking for a flexible job that fits perfectly into your life? Become an Uber Eats delivery courier!

Decide when you work, cycle through the city, and earn money while doing it. With Uber Eats, you enjoy the freedom to work on your own terms. 

What are you going to do?
As a courier for Uber Eats, you’ll be the link between restaurants and hungry customers.

Your main tasks are:

- Picking up meals from local restaurants
- Navigating the fastest route using the Uber Eats app
- Delivering with a smile and punctuality – keeping customers happy and well-fed

What do we offer?
- Salary: Starting at €16,19 gross/hour (age 21+), including holiday pay
- Peak earnings: Up to € 18,19 gross/hour with daily bonuses and and keep 100% of your tips
- Gear: We provide the necessary gear to keep you safe and comfortable during delivery – delivery bag, helmet and phone holder
- Benefits: 20 paid vacation days + pension contributions from day one
- Flexible schedule: Plan all of your work, yourself through your phone beforehand. We do not set your work schedule

Where will you work?
Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. Our shared goal is for all our deliveries to be emission-free by 2040. 

Be part of a movement that’s changing the way the world eats.

To start as a delivery courier with Uber Eats, you must meet the following conditions:

•            You are at least 16 years old

•            You live in the Netherlands

•            You speak either Dutch or English

•            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

Do you enjoy working with modern CNC machines? Are you technically minded and do you work accurately? Then this job in Waalwijk could be the perfect fit for you. You will work with a brand new 5 axis CNC machine and have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and grow within the company.

What are you going to do?
As a CNC Operator, you make sure large sandwich panels are cut and milled to exact specifications.

- Prepare the CNC machine and place the panels correctly
- Enter the required data and select the correct programs
- Monitor the machine during the production process
- Check the quality and make adjustments when necessary
- Analyze and replace tools when needed
- Move panels using an overhead crane
- Keep your workplace clean and organized

You will work Monday to Friday from 07:00 to 16:00. If you perform well, there is a possibility of being taken over by the company.

What do we offer?
- Starting salary of €16.33 gross per hour during the first 4 weeks, increasing to €16.72 gross per hour afterwards
- 8.33% holiday allowance
- 25 paid vacation days based on full time employment
- Pension from day 1
- Access to the Adecco Academy for your personal and professional development
- Plenty of opportunities to grow into more complex machines, products or other departments
- Work clothing is provided and there is a possibility of a permanent contract

Where will you work?
You will join an innovative and stable manufacturer of custom made sandwich panels for the automotive and bodywork industry. You will work in a professional production team with modern machinery and a strong focus on quality. There are plenty of opportunities to learn new techniques and develop your career within the company.

What do we ask?
- Experience working with CNC machines is an advantage
- You work accurately and have good technical insight
- You can read technical drawings or are willing to learn
- You can work independently and take responsibility
- You speak Dutch or Engli
